name: Subagent Workflow
description: Wire coding-agent harnesses into a workflow on a canvas: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, opencode, Aider, Cursor Agent, the built-in Pi runner, or a custom command. Bookend it with start and end nodes, drop in human approval gates, and give each node three things — its provider, its model and its user message — then run the whole graph server-side and watch every node stream its output. A Pi node picks from every model this app can run, grouped by provider (`provider/model`), reference files you add are injected into a node's message with their paths and descriptions, and the end node shows the workflow's final output. The wiring decides the order: nodes connected in parallel run in parallel, a chain runs one after another, and the start and end nodes take as many connections as you draw. Runs can start on a schedule or on observed events, and every past run stays in the workspace's history to reopen.
author: Pi Scope
